title: Tapped Delay
text: Delay scalar signal multiple sample periods and output all delayed versions, 1 input, 1 output, no direct feedthrough, {Sample time} sets Time between samples; {Initial condition} sets the initial output, {Number of delays} sets the number of discrete-time operators, {Order output vector starting with} sets the order of output and {Include current input in output vector}. Values come from the instance.
